name: EU/EEA/Swiss Right of Residence

requirements.blocker_text: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens may reside in Belgium freely for up to 3 months on a valid ID card or passport alone.

Beyond 3 months, must submit a declaration of registration to the municipal authority, on grounds of employment/self-employment, active job-seeking, self-sufficiency plus comprehensive health insurance, or student status. Missing the 3-month deadline triggers a EUR 200 administrative fine.
requirements.fix_path: Register with the municipal authority within 3 months of arrival.

evidence_required.document: Valid EU/EEA/Swiss ID card or passport
Employment contract, business registration, jobseeker registration, proof of means/insurance, or enrolment documentation (matching the chosen ground)

outcome.duration_length: declaration of registration is not time-limited, subject to continuing to meet the grounds; permanent residence available after 5 years

sources.title: IBZ -- Right of Entry and Residence (EU citizens, more than 3 months): registration deadline and EUR 200 fine, qualifying grounds (employment, job-seeking, self-sufficiency, student)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Belgium). pr_after_months (60) and citizenship_after_months (60) use be_permanent_residence.json/be_naturalisation.json's general 5-year figures as baselines; no EU-citizen-specific reduced track distinct from these general figures was confirmed in this pass.
